profile.headline: iOS Software Engineer at Airbnb

positions.title: Software Engineer, iOS
positions.description: iOS Software Engineer on the Airbnb app

positions.title: Knowledge Management Editor
positions.description:
• Work as part of a global team to write workflow documentation and related customer response macros
• Led migration of entire knowledge base from Zendesk to Confluence
• Manage Confluence space, permissions, and plug-ins
• Manage and maintain key relationships with cross-functional operational teams to ensure optimal content change implementation
• Code JavaScript tools to edit HTML code and run queries using SQL

positions.title: Project Manager, Nea Kavala Refugee Camp
positions.description:
Disaster and Humanitarian Relief
• Revamped the weekly schedule of activities and managed the translation of the document into six languages: English, French, Arabic, Urdu, Persian, and Tigrinya
• Collaborated with and managed a six-person team to develop and submit the NGO Registration
Application to the Greek Ministry of Education
• Developed and implemented a two-week sports camp for hundreds of refugee children, focusing on sportsmanship and resilience through play
• Empowered refugees to take leadership roles within their community
• Coordinated with the Red Cross, the Greek police and Greek military to provide resources, such as
transportation, to better serve refugees

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.description:
• Wrote JavaScript examples and documentation
• Maintained the Geocoding, Directions, Tilequery, Uploads, Styles and Static API documentation
• Advocated for the customer and made sure their voice was heard
• Managed relationships with clients and customers
• Responsible for support escalations, triaging, fixing bugs, and implementing product enhancements
• Represented Mapbox at tech conferences and meetups and helped drive adoption of Open Source
• Built a community around mapping and humanitarian work

positions.title: Support Lead/Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained the support model that decreased total ticket response time from 5 days to 24 hours
• Initiated and led projects that resulted in a 97% decrease in ticket volume and time savings equivalent to 2 full-time employees
• Became a product expert for the Geotrigger Service, a product used by 3.1 million devices
• Created data and metric reports for managers to drive actionable insights and detect product trends
• Responsible for support escalations, triaging, fixing bugs, and implementing product enhancements
• Led a team of 4 developers in the creation of educational curriculum and set up a 3-day workflow training for 15 Support Analysts at headquarters
• Created help content, wrote FAQ’s, email campaigns, and instructional guides for iOS and Android, decreasing support inquiries by 18%
• Designed and developed the Startup Program website, application process, and Salesforce integration
• Wrote end-to-end tests using JavaScript, Selenium, and Jasmine for the ArcGIS for Developers site
• Represented Esri at major conferences around the country to drive awareness about their products and open source contributions

positions.title: Pages Operations
positions.description:
• Founding member of the Pages Operations team
• Managed projects with various teams to provide solutions for all managed clients, including Fortune 500 companies, that resulted in saving multiple FTE's and increasing revenue 
• Built and maintained the support model that decreased total response time from 3 days to 11 hours for managed clients; currently used in North America, Latin America, EMEA, and APAC regions
• Amended global Pages policy that affected 70 million+ Page admins
• Monitored trends and analyzed large datasets using SQL to drive actionable insight to the company
• Provided business and policy consulting to clients including major retailers, financial institutions, local governments, and ad agencies to develop their online strategy
• Conducted training and created webinars for Salesforce, internal tools, Pages policy, and workflows

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
• Restructured client information databases for faster access
• Scheduled appointments and answered questions for account holders

positions.title: Finance Manager
positions.description:
• Effectively ran a small business and grew operations from 5 to 54 units and from 3 to 15 employees 
• Negotiated contracts with property management and investment companies
• Planned budget, issued employee payroll, prepared and filed business taxes
• Coordinated employee crews across the Chicago metro area and audited job performance

positions.title: Student Admissions Representative
positions.description: • Selected to give tours and conduct panels in Spanish and English for groups of up to 35 prospective students and parents to promote student life and Bradley’s culture

positions.title: Campaign Intern
positions.description:
• Planned and executed fundraising events of up to 500 people by coordinating with vendors, volunteers, and guest speakers
• Oversaw guest relations and managed volunteers during fundraisers in order to ensure a successful fundraiser and enjoyable experience for constituents
• Compiled voter and constituent data for Illinois' 18th Congressional district into Aristotle 360 database

positions.title: Clerk
positions.description:
• Conducted interviews, hired applicants, and approved payroll
• Gathered, organized, and interpreted sensitive location data to be used by the Census Bureau and employees

positions.title: Summer Academy Teacher
positions.description:
• Taught Literature and Social Studies for grades 5 through 8
• Taught 'French Conversation and Grammar' as an elective
• Lesson-planned and handled parent-teacher relationships

positions.title: Bilingual Teacher
positions.description:
• Translated all curriculum from english to spanish for ESL students
• Taught 2nd grade class in spanish

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Dispatched by the Sheriff’s office to search and rescue any missing persons, including trail, open-grid, closed-grid and evidence searches in Multnomah County and surrounding areas in Oregon

• Trained in survival, navigation, and wilderness first aid

• CPR, First Aid, and FEMA Certified

• Prepare and run practices for 10 to 15 middle school students once a week
• Coach them every weekend during the season when they play other Portland area teams
• Teach them the values of teamwork, fairness, and Spirit of the Game
